title: Build Manifest
description: Declares build steps, inputs, outputs, and dependencies for a pipeline

manifestVersion.description: Schema version for the manifest format

pipeline.description: Pipeline name — must match orchestrator's pipeline identifier

description.description: Human-readable description of this pipeline's purpose

manualOnly.description: If true, pipeline is never auto-triggered by the orchestrator

jenkinsPath.description: Path to the pipeline's Jenkinsfile (relative to repo root). Required for dispatchable pipelines; absent for graph-only pipelines that are never directly dispatched by the orchestrator.

jenkinsJob.description: Jenkins multibranch job name, when it differs from the pipeline name. Defaults to the pipeline name.

jenkinsBranch.description: Pin the dispatched branch instead of following the orchestrator's own branch. Required for pipelines whose Jenkins job tracks a DIFFERENT repository (e.g. a submodule's job), where this repo's branch name is meaningless.

triggersGenesis.description: If true and this pipeline builds, elohim-genesis is auto-included on dev branches.

cascades.description: If true, dependents of this pipeline auto-build when it builds. Set false for leaf pipelines that produce artifacts consumed only by themselves.

longRunning.description: If true, the orchestrator fires this pipeline as fire-and-forget (doesn't block waiting for it). Used for pipelines that take >15 minutes.

dependsOn.description: Pipeline names this pipeline depends on for execution ordering.

steps.description: Map of step name to step definition

dir.description: Working directory for running the quality gate

steps.description: Which manifest steps trigger this gate project (default: all steps)

inputs.description: Gate-only change inputs. These select a local check without creating a Jenkins pipeline step.

projects.description: Map of hook project name to gate config

gateRun.description: How a gate project is executed locally. just / root-just run a recipe; attested runs nothing and reads the pinned commit's upstream attestation instead.

kind.title: GateRunKind
kind.description: just = recipe in the project dir's justfile; root-just = recipe in the repo-root justfile; attested = no local recipe — the gate reads the attestation the component's own CI recorded at the pinned commit

recipe.description: Recipe name to invoke (just and root-just only)

env.description: Extra environment exported around this project's cargo run — never passed through argv. The declaration home for per-project resource caps (CARGO_BUILD_JOBS, RUST_TEST_THREADS) so a heavy crate's gate cannot cross the workspace RAM guard's shed line.

gateAttestation.description: Where the pinned commit's attestation is read from. Exactly three fields by design: no thresholds, no signer lists, no reputation (spec 2026-09-23 §7).

provider.title: AttestationProvider
provider.description: github-checks = GET /repos/{repo}/commits/{sha}/check-runs, the named check's newest run

check.description: The check-run name that stands for 'this commit is attested' (brit: 'Tests pass'; rakia: 'test'; sophia: 'build')

artifacts.description: Named output artifacts this step produces

verify.description: Shell command to confirm artifact was produced

depends.description: Step dependencies — bare name for same-manifest, 'pipeline:step' for cross-manifest

function.description: Jenkinsfile helper function name (null if inline stage)

class.title: RunClass
class.description: Run class (mirror of rakia steps[].class), ordered build > deploy > verify > measure > profile. A dispatch's class is the highest class among its stale steps; a class executes only the steps at or below it. Absent means build.
